The committee finds that the proposed building is too large, too grey, too loud and too close to the river. It recommends that the design be reduced, softened, painted and moved. The architect has declined all four requests and wishes to proceed as drawn. The committee notes the decision with regret and some admiration. A second meeting will be held in the spring, weather permitting, to discuss the matter of the staircase, which nobody has yet been able to find.
